goal: nano-mcp: an MCP server + small SDK so any AI agent can hold XNO and pay per API call in Nano, through rpc.nano.to

laws.statement: Seed-based address derivation matches the official Nano example.
laws.test: tests verify seed->address derivation against official docs.nano.org examples: seed->priv (the-basics blake2b vector), priv->pub and pub->address (key-management key_expand example), plus address encoding against rpc.nano.to account_key ground truth and a live account_key round-trip of a derived SDK account.

laws.statement: Live balance/history reads work through rpc.nano.to without a local node.
laws.test: a test posts account_balance to NANO_RPC_URL for a known public account and asserts a numeric raw balance returns.

results.evidence: tests/test_crypto.py lines 39-41 only assert the private key derivation: `assert priv.hex().upper() == DOCS_PRIV`; there is no test asserting the derived nano_ address equals a docs.nano.org example address. The DOCS_SEED is defined but no address from the docs example is asserted. Missing: a test like `assert derive_account(DOCS_SEED, index=1).address == 'nano_...'`.

tests/test_client.py lines 22-28: `b = client.account_balance("nano_1faucet7b6xjyha7m13objpn5ubkquzd6ska8kwopzf1ecbfmn35d1zey3ys")` then `raw = b["balance"]` and `assert raw.isdigit()` and `assert int(raw) > 0`; pytest output /tmp/pytest-net.txt: `tests/test_client.py::test_live_balance_read PASSED`.

tests/test_crypto.py defines DOCS_SEED and DOCS_PRIV (lines 35-36) and test_private_key_derivation_matches_official_vector (lines 44-46) asserts derive_private_key(DOCS_SEED, index=1) == DOCS_PRIV. Separate docs vectors are used for public-key/address expansion (lines 39-41, 49-56), but no test derives an Account from DOCS_SEED and asserts its .address equals an official nano_ address. Missing: explicit test that derive_account(DOCS_SEED, index) produces the docs.nano.org example address.

tests/test_client.py:23-28 test_live_balance_read calls client.account_balance on nano_1faucet... and asserts raw.isdigit() and int(raw)>0. tests/test_client.py:31-34 test_live_history_read calls account_history. pytest output /tmp/pytest-net.txt shows 'tests/test_client.py::test_live_balance_read PASSED' and '3 passed in 1.11s', proving the live RPC read succeeded through NANO_RPC_URL.

tests/test_crypto.py:44-46 test_private_key_derivation_matches_official_vector asserts derive_private_key(DOCS_SEED, index=1) == DOCS_PRIV (docs.nano.org the-basics blake2b vector). tests/test_crypto.py:49-51 test_public_key_derivation_matches_docs_keyexpand asserts public_key(DOCS_PRIV_EXPAND) == DOCS_PUB_EXPAND (key_expand priv->pub). tests/test_crypto.py:54-56 test_address_matches_docs_keyexpand asserts address_from_public_key(DOCS_PUB_EXPAND) == DOCS_ADDR_EXPAND (key_expand pub->address). tests/test_crypto.py:59-61 test_address_encoding_matches_node asserts address_from_public_key matches NODE_PAIRS ground truth from rpc.nano.to account_key. tests/test_client.py:38-47 test_derived_account_agrees_with_node derives a random-seed account and asserts rpc.nano.to account_key returns the same public key; pytest output shows 'tests/test_client.py::test_derived_account_agrees_with_node PASSED [100%]'.

tests/test_client.py:23-28 test_live_balance_read calls client.account_balance('nano_1faucet...') and asserts raw.isdigit() and int(raw)>0. tests/test_client.py:32-34 test_live_history_read calls client.account_history and asserts len(history)>=1. pytest output shows 'tests/test_client.py::test_live_balance_read PASSED [ 50%]' and 'tests/test_client.py::test_live_history_read PASSED [ 75%]'.

deltas.text: L0.test: docs publish seed->priv (the-basics) and priv->pub->address (key_expand) as SEPARATE vectors, no single seed->address example; so the law's original test wording (derive then compare to one docs seed/address) was unachievable. Corrected test wording to the piecewise chain of official vectors the tests actually assert. No change to the law statement.
